title: Choose the visual world
question: Which world should VIZ Creative inhabit? Each option keeps the full render visible, restrained type scale, and a direct project-start path.

options.label: Datum Field
options.lineage: surveyor optics, site datums, and instrument plates
options.thesis: The portfolio behaves like a precision instrument for turning spatial intent into a decision.
options.viewport: A fully visible 16:9 showreel sits inside a calibrated cobalt field; a slim datum rail carries the studio name, service line, and a compact project-start action while the frame expands on scroll.
options.risk: The instrument language can feel clinical if the human occupation inside the renders is not allowed to lead.

raised.raise: Every label earns a fixed information role, so dense sections remain instantly scannable.
The hero transformation is continuous and live, but never distorts the original render.
The visitor sees a decisive progression from idea to project milestone rather than decorative motion.
Deeper scroll reveals useful project-fit detail without shrinking the main work into cards.

options.label: Material Index
options.lineage: architectural material libraries and sample-room index cards
options.thesis: Every service and project reads as a material decision laid out for close inspection.
options.viewport: A quiet mineral field holds one uncropped moving render beside a narrow specimen index, with tactile labels and compact actions aligned like sample metadata.
options.risk: Material-library language is highly credible for architecture, but it is also the most familiar grounded direction in this field.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.lineage: inhabited architectural sections and solar studies
options.thesis: The site is one long inhabited section, with the showreel as the moving band of light that connects idea to occupation.
options.viewport: A bright sectional composition keeps the full video centered while time stamps, service notes, and a single gold path establish the scroll sequence.
options.case: It identifies immediately with architecture and makes scrollytelling native, while the technical metaphor is slightly narrower than VIZ's interior-design offer.
options.risk: Too many annotations would turn a persuasive portfolio into a diagram rather than an experience.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: Services and projects become directly addressable numbered pages.
options.viewport: A rigid information grid indexes the showreel and studio offer by page number.
options.case: Strong clarity, but its retro broadcast identity overwhelms the spatial work.
options.kept: Fixed information roles and uncompromising scanability.
options.risk: The studio would read as a media experiment before it reads as an architecture practice.

options.label: ASCII Live Scene
options.lineage: live scenes rendered as character density
options.thesis: The showreel transforms into a live field of typographic light.
options.viewport: One responsive character field reacts to the hero film and resolves into the studio offer.
options.case: Technically memorable, but it destroys the fidelity clients need to judge the render itself.
options.kept: A single continuous transformation rather than scattered effects.
options.risk: The medium would obscure the portfolio's strongest evidence.

options.label: Power Hammer
options.thesis: Each scroll beat visibly forms an idea into a resolved environment.
options.viewport: A dark measured stage reveals one transformation per deliberate scroll strike.
options.case: It explains transformation clearly, but its brutal industrial character contradicts the refined interior work.
options.risk: The visual world would promise fabrication more than design and visualization.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished architectural-visualization portfolio built around full-bleed work, quiet navigation, services, process, and a contact close.
canonCard.viewport: A full-width showreel sits behind a centered studio statement, followed by a conventional project grid.
canonCard.risk: Credible and elegant, but intentionally difficult to distinguish from other premium visualization studios.
